name: Um Singular Retrato
source:
At what point does a simple desire become an obsession? This is one of the dilemmas faced by Beatrice, a photography student as bitter as reality itself. Within a tangle of unfolding mysteries, she will discover that the most beautiful manifestation of the past holds a chaotic future. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4182230/A_Singular_Portrait/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
一个简单的愿望什么时候会变成痴迷？这是比阿特丽斯（Beatrice）所面临的困境之一，她是一名摄影学生，与现实本身一样痛苦。在一团正在展开的谜团中，她会发现过去最美丽的表现却蕴藏着混乱的未来。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4182230/A_Singular_Portrait/]Steam[/url]]
